items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well there's another white pianist I've heard of, Kid Ross I believe. Did you know him? ... [INTERVIEWEE] No I didn't know him.

ctx.x: That's right. He was on that record too. That's right, Arthur Campbell. And he was a good piano player. Now these fellas would play piano during those times. They had so many of them that I could name, but they wasn't the really top piano players. Now we had another piano player play good, a white boy played piano, was a very good piano player during that time. He was some kin to Shields, to Larry Shields, the trumpet player. Well they used to, I don't know if it was his cousin or what, but they used to live at…
Well there's another white pianist I've heard of, Kid Ross I believe. Did you know him? No. I think he played at Lula White's house for a while.
No I didn't know him. I know Lula White's nephew.
